**EarthGuard: Explore the Ripple Effects Across Earth's Systems**

EarthGuard is an interactive educational web application that uses NASA satellite imagery to help people understand how Earth's systems are connected. It explores how dry conditions can affect soil and vegetation, how wildfires produce smoke that impacts air quality, and how ecosystems recover after environmental disturbances.

The project uses NASA's MODIS Terra satellite imagery through NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS). Users can explore an interactive map and select different environmental pathways to understand these connections.

EarthGuard aims to make complex environmental information easier to understand and encourage awareness of our planet. It is an educational prototype, not a forecasting or emergency warning system.
details:
EarthGuard: Explore the Ripple Effects Across Earth's Systems

Project Description

EarthGuard is an interactive educational web application that helps people understand how Earth's natural systems are connected. It uses NASA satellite imagery to explore how environmental changes in one part of Earth can affect other parts.

The Problem

Environmental changes do not happen separately. For example, dry conditions can affect soil and vegetation, increase the risk of wildfires, and contribute to smoke that affects air quality and ecosystems.

Our Solution

EarthGuard makes these connections easier to understand through an interactive map and three educational pathways:

  1. Dry Conditions: Explore how a lack of rainfall can affect soil and vegetation.
  2. Wildfires and Smoke: Understand how wildfires can affect the atmosphere and air quality.
  3. Ecosystem Recovery: Learn how plants and ecosystems can recover after environmental disturbances.

NASA Data Used

The project uses NASA's MODIS Terra satellite imagery through NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS).

Main Features

  • Interactive satellite imagery map.
  • Three environmental learning pathways.
  • Simple explanations of connections between Earth's systems.
  • Educational information about environmental changes.

Project Goal

Our goal is to make Earth science easier to understand and encourage people to care for our planet.

Project Limitations

EarthGuard is an educational prototype. It does not predict wildfires, measure live air quality, or provide emergency warnings.
